subject: Important Announcement: Upcoming Office Closure
body: Dear Team, I am writing to inform you that our office will be closed on Friday, December 24th, in observance of the Christmas holiday. Please make sure to complete all pending tasks and prepare for the closure in advance. If you have any urgent matters that need attention, please reach out to me directly. Thank you for your cooperation. Wishing you a joyful holiday season! Best regards, [Your Name]
